The previous run failed because of a sizing bug. `Wp = Wn·In_t/Ip_unit` scaled the PMOS width by Wn a second time, making it about 4× too wide. MP1 then went into triode and pulled vout to 1.69 V.

This version keeps the self-biased complementary inverter with Rf to the 0.75 V input. Wp is now solved so the PMOS current matches the NMOS current plus the Rf current at vout = 0.9 V. The branch current rises to about 55 µA to give a total gm near 1.2 mS. Rf is lowered to about 12 kΩ so that G = 1/Rf sets both the gain (about 9.8) and the bandwidth (about 30 MHz).

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Wp sizing bug (extra Wn factor) made PMOS 4x too wide -> triode, vout 1.69V. Fix Wp solve to centre vout at 0.9V, raise current to ~55uA for gm~1.2mS, set Rf~12k so gain~9.8 (19.8dB) and f3db~30MHz."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Wn":     (7.0,   2.0,   20.0),    # NMOS driver width [um]
    "Ln":     (0.18,  0.15,  0.5),     # NMOS length [um]
    "Lp":     (0.18,  0.15,  0.5),     # PMOS length [um]
    "p_trim": (1.0,   0.8,   1.25),    # PMOS width trim vs. computed width (sets vout_dc)
    "Rf":     (12e3,  6e3,   60e3),    # load/centring resistor vout->vin [ohm]
    "Wb":     (1.0,   0.5,   4.0),     # ibias sink diode width [um]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref_assumed = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)

    Wn, Ln, Lp, Rf = p["Wn"], p["Ln"], p["Lp"], p["Rf"]
    vgs_n = vin
    vsg_p = VDD - vin

    # Size PMOS so KCL holds at vout = 0.9 V: Ip = In + (vt - vin)/Rf
    v_t = 0.9
    In_t = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vgs_n, v_t)["Id"]
    Ip_need = In_t + (v_t - vin) / Rf
    Ip_unit = lut.op("p", 1.0, Lp, vsg_p, VDD - v_t)["Id"]   # current per 1 um width
    Wp = max(0.42, min(200.0, Ip_need / max(Ip_unit, 1e-12) * p["p_trim"]))

    def kcl(v):
        In = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vgs_n, v)["Id"]
        Ip = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_p, VDD - v)["Id"]
        return Ip - In - (v - vin) / Rf

    lo, hi = 0.02, VDD - 0.02
    for _ in range(50):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if kcl(mid) > 0:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    vout = 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    on = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vgs_n, vout)
    op_ = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_p, VDD - vout)
    G = 1.0 / Rf
    gm = on["gm"] + op_["gm"]
    gds = on["gds"] + op_["gds"]
    gain = (gm - G) / (gds + G)
    cpar = 0.35 * (on["cgg"] + op_["cgg"])
    ctot = cl + cpar
    f3db = (gds + G) / (2 * PI * ctot)
    gbw = gain * f3db
    idd = op_["Id"]
    power = VDD * (idd + iref_assumed)
    swing = VDD - max(on["vdsat"], 0.1) - max(op_["vdsat"], 0.1)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.M("MP1", "vout", "vin", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "vin", Rf)
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wb"], 1.0)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": 20 * math.log10(max(gain, 1e-6)),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
